purpose: Price a strictly narrowed current-input feasibility reader, distinct from the earlier per-file rule. No whole-Cargo time or product claim.
normal_mode: LLVM 23, Linux x86_64, opt-level 1, debug assertions, line tables only, incremental compilation, LTO off, no bitcode embedding. Full original compiler argument bytes bind the external mode.
canonical: An in-memory scratch module through stock deadargelim,globaldce and typed LLVM metadata remapping, with a single global order/equality of source lines, reserving 0 and 1 and preserving file, checksum kind, column, inline chain and other metadata. Stronger than the prior per-file-only proof.
further: If the three native keys admit the first and exclude both original runtime changes, plus the negative and sentinel controls, check all 21 fresh OLD/NEW inputs from original archive. Record all misses including cross-file order.
measure: Use Callgrind x86_64 guest Ir. Record current NEW parse+verify separate from policy. Policy includes the full eligibility, stock two passes, native graph lookup/rewrite, complete serialization with SHA-256 and placement encoding; external output formatting, input download and custody checks are outside. Same executable and LLVM as native green. Repeat representative once. Do not add guest and hardware instruction counts.
limits: Single process on one CPU, bound peak memory and avoid any unbounded durable profiler output. No compiler bootstrap or expansion of the original archive. Preserve affirmative/error receipts. Whole-Cargo and debugger-output sufficiency are independent further gates.
